import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src/py"))
import heliopy as H

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "out_literature"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
KB, MU0 = 1.380649e-23, 4e-7 * np.pi
AU = 1.495978707e8


def grid(nlat=360, nlon=720):
    lat = np.linspace(-90 + 90 / nlat, 90 - 90 / nlat, nlat)
    lon = np.linspace(180 / nlon, 360 - 180 / nlon, nlon)
    return lat, lon, *np.meshgrid(np.radians(lat), np.radians(lon), indexing="ij")


def recipe_a(path, dxi=18.5, br=41.0):
    lat, lon, LA, LO = grid()
    xi = np.full(LA.shape, np.inf)
    for m in range(6):
        c = np.radians(30 + 60 * m)
        d = np.arccos(np.clip(np.cos(LA) * np.cos(LO - c), -1, 1))
        xi = np.minimum(xi, d)
    a = 0.5 * (np.tanh(30 * (xi + np.radians(dxi))) - np.tanh(30 * (xi - np.radians(dxi))))
    v = 300 * (1 + a)
    n = 120 * (1 + a) ** -1.5
    T = 0.16e6 * 120 / n
    d = np.stack([v, n, T, np.full_like(v, br), v])[None].astype(np.float32)
    H.write_bnd(path, [0.0], lat, lon, d)


def recipe_c(path, hw=27.0):
    lat, lon, LA, LO = grid()
    S = lambda x: np.where(np.abs(x) <= np.radians(hw), np.sinc(x / np.radians(hw)) ** 2, 0.0)
    u = np.full(LA.shape, 290.0)
    for c in (60.0, 180.0, 300.0):
        dphi = (LO - np.radians(c) + np.pi) % (2 * np.pi) - np.pi
        u += 290 * S(LA) * S(dphi)
    d = np.stack([u, np.full_like(u, 370.0), np.full_like(u, 1.12e6), np.zeros_like(u), u])[None].astype(np.float32)
    H.write_bnd(path, [0.0], lat, lon, d)


def run(name, maker, r0, gamma, omega, nr, nt, nphi, latmax, t_end_d, rout=2.5):
    wd = OUT / name
    wd.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    maker(wd / "bnd.bin")
    cfg = dict(nr=nr, nt=nt, np=nphi, rin_au=r0, rout_au=rout, latmax_deg=latmax, gamma=gamma, gravity=1, xalpha=0.0, bnd_file=wd / "bnd.bin", phi0_deg=0, omega_deg_day=omega,
               t_start_s=0, t_end_s=t_end_d * 86400, snap_times_s=t_end_d * 86400, probe_dt_s=1e9, out_dir=wd, diag_dt_s=86400 * 5)
    H.write_cfg(wd / "cfg.txt", cfg)
    rc = H.run(wd / "cfg.txt", log=wd / "stdout.txt", mem="6G")
    return wd, rc


def profile(wd, R=1.0, omega=14.71):
    t, r, th, ph, d = H.read_snap(sorted(wd.glob("snap_*.bin"))[-1])
    j = np.argmin(np.abs(th - np.pi / 2))
    i = np.argmin(np.abs(r - R))
    n, vr, vp, T = d[0][i, j], d[1][i, j], d[3][i, j], d[4][i, j]
    B = np.sqrt(d[5][i, j] ** 2 + d[6][i, j] ** 2 + d[7][i, j] ** 2)
    pT = (2 * n * 1e6 * KB * T + (B * 1e-9) ** 2 / (2 * MU0)) * 1e12
    om = omega * np.pi / 180 / 86400
    defl = np.degrees(np.arctan2(vp, vr))
    corot = np.degrees(np.arctan2(vp - om * r[i] * AU, vr))
    return dict(phi=np.degrees(ph), n=n, v=vr, T=T, B=B, pT=pT, defl=defl, corot=corot, r=r[i])


def summarize_a(p):
    fast = p["v"] > 550
    slow = p["v"] < 360
    return {"r_au": float(p["r"]), "n_max": float(p["n"].max()), "B_max": float(p["B"].max()), "pT_max_pPa": float(p["pT"].max()), "T_max": float(p["T"].max()),
            "v_fast_plateau": float(np.percentile(p["v"], 90)), "n_min": float(p["n"].min()), "B_min": float(p["B"].min()),
            "n_upstream_slow": float(np.median(p["n"][slow])) if slow.any() else None, "v_min": float(p["v"].min()), "T_upstream_slow": float(np.median(p["T"][slow])) if slow.any() else None,
            "defl_max_deg": float(p["defl"].max()), "defl_min_deg": float(p["defl"].min()), "corot_angle_slow": float(np.median(p["corot"][slow])) if slow.any() else None, "corot_angle_fast": float(np.median(p["corot"][fast])) if fast.any() else None,
            "max_dv_per_cell": float(np.max(np.abs(np.diff(p["v"])))), "max_dn_rel_per_cell": float(np.max(np.abs(np.diff(np.log(p["n"])))))}


TARGET_A = {"n_max": (22.5, 23.5), "B_max": 15.0, "pT_max_pPa": 155.0, "T_max": 2.0e5, "v_fast_plateau": (600, 615), "n_min": (0.3, 0.5), "B_min": 0.7, "n_upstream_slow": 4.0, "v_upstream_slow": 335.0,
            "T_upstream_slow": 1e4, "defl_max_deg": 10.0, "defl_min_deg": -7.5, "corot_angle_slow": -50.0, "corot_angle_fast": -36.0}
TARGET_C = {"v_slow_1au": 401.0, "n_slow_1au": 7.1, "T_slow_1au": 8.0e4, "v_peak_1au": 625.0, "n_peak_1au": 18.0, "n_min_1au": 4.2, "uphi_max": 28.0, "uphi_min": -18.0}


def plot_a(profiles, out):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(4, 1, figsize=(8, 11), sharex=True)
    for lab, p in profiles.items():
        k = np.argmax(p["n"])
        x = (p["phi"] - p["phi"][k] + 180) % 360 - 180 + 189
        o = np.argsort(x)
        ax[0].plot(x[o], p["v"][o], label=lab)
        ax[1].plot(x[o], p["n"][o])
        ax[2].plot(x[o], p["B"][o])
        ax[3].plot(x[o], p["pT"][o])
    for a, (y, t) in zip(ax, ((610, "v fast ~600-615"), (22.5, "n_max 22.5 (CRONOS)"), (15, "|B|max 15 nT"), (155, "p_T,max 155 pPa"))):
        a.axhline(y, color="k", ls=":", lw=0.8)
        a.text(150, y, t, fontsize=7)
    for a, l in zip(ax, ("v_r [km/s]", "n [cm^-3]", "|B| [nT]", "p_T [pPa]")):
        a.set_ylabel(l)
    ax[3].set_xlim(150, 230)
    ax[3].set_xlabel("longitude, aligned so n peak at 189 deg (Wiengarten+2014 Fig. 4b frame)")
    ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(out, dpi=120)
    plt.close(fig)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    which = sys.argv[1]
    res_p = OUT / "results.json"
    res = json.loads(res_p.read_text()) if res_p.exists() else {}
    if which == "A":
        profs = {}
        for tag, (nr, nt, nphi) in {"A_1deg": (512, 144, 360), "A_0p5deg": (512, 288, 720)}.items():
            if len(sys.argv) > 2 and tag not in sys.argv[2:]:
                continue
            wd, rc = run(tag, recipe_a, 0.3, 1.5, 14.71, nr, nt, nphi, 72.0, 22.0)
            for R in (1.0, 2.0):
                p = profile(wd, R)
                profs[f"{tag} r={R}"] = p
                res[f"{tag}_r{R}"] = summarize_a(p)
        plot_a({k: v for k, v in profs.items() if "r=1.0" in k}, OUT / "recipeA_1au.png")
        res["target_A_1au"] = TARGET_A
    if which == "C":
        wd, rc = run("C_1deg", recipe_c, 0.16, 5 / 3, 14.18, 512, 120, 360, 60.0, 25.0)
        p = profile(wd, 1.0, 14.18)
        base = np.percentile(p["v"], 5)
        res["C_1deg_r1.0"] = {"v_slow_1au": float(np.percentile(p["v"], 5)), "n_slow_1au": float(np.median(p["n"][p["v"] < base + 5])), "T_slow_1au": float(np.median(p["T"][p["v"] < base + 5])),
                               "v_peak_1au": float(p["v"].max()), "n_peak_1au": float(p["n"].max()), "n_min_1au": float(p["n"].min()), "uphi_max": float((p["v"] * np.tan(np.radians(p["defl"]))).max()), "uphi_min": float((p["v"] * np.tan(np.radians(p["defl"]))).min())}
        for R in (0.8, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0):
            q = profile(wd, R, 14.18)
            res[f"C_1deg_r{R}_max_dv_per_cell"] = float(np.max(np.abs(np.diff(q["v"]))))
        res["target_C_1au"] = TARGET_C
    res_p.write_text(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
    print(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
